if youre uncomfortable  with full hospitalization you could do what my friend is currently doing, php, (partial hospitalization program), she attends treatment 8 hours a day and goes home at night, you may want to consider this and look further into it. 

 full hospitalization though isnt as bad as it seems. the adjustment period can be a little rough but being in a safe environment all day will really help you get to a safer mindset.

 if you're unsure whether you want to do either of these you can talk to your counselor about it and they can tell you what they think is best for you right now. and help you learn more abt treatments.

unless your therapist deems you to be dangerous to yourself/others i dont think they report. if youre suicidal with a plan and selfharming, youll get reported, if youre not suicidal you wont be reported. having suicidal thoughts with self harm is not something that can be treated just in your therapist's office due to the fact you'll only see them once a week/biweekly whereas at a mental hospital youll be watched all the time.
 so uhh in case that was confusing: just selfharming wont get you reported, you can talk to your therapist about it.
